name: Do I need special permits to build a guest home on my property?

mainEntity.name: Do I need special permits to build a guest home on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building a guest home, or ADU, requires specific permits from your local city or county planning department. These permits ensure compliance with zoning laws, building codes, and safety regulations. The process typically involves submitting architectural plans, site plans, and utility connection details for review. Zen Tiny Homes assists clients with navigating the permitting process, preparing necessary documentation, and liaising with local authorities in areas like Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, and Escondido to help secure approvals efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, special permits are required for guest homes to ensure compliance with local zoning and building codes. We assist with the permitting process.
